oakA.notes: Crown 64x80 reads well with upper-left light and a dark lower-right mass. The lit body colour 6ea03a is almost the same value as grass 729c44, so on open grass the upper-left silhouette fades out (new_art_4x 1x x0-20 y10-30). It stays readable because b0cc58 highlights and the dark right side carry the form.

oakB.notes: Same family as oakA. Trunk and roots are clean.

oakA_v2.notes: Its own drawing: 2381 of 3596 art pixels differ from oakA. Not a re-tint.

oakA_v3.notes: 2303 of 3216 art pixels differ from oakA, and 2595 differ from v2.

oakB_v2.notes: 1467 of 2071 art pixels differ from oakB.

oakB_v3.notes: 1117 of 1670 art pixels differ from oakB. The right lobe is a little blocky (4x x1440-1470 y140-250) but fine at 1x.

bushC.notes: Low loaf shape that sits on the tile bottom. Same palette family.

city_kits.notes: No crown is flush with a tile edge: the longest non-grass run on any edge of an AFTER tile is 3 px at 1x (tiles at 2x sheet (304,398) and (248,414) come within 1 px on the left). Old V-branch trunks and flared roots are fully gone. The warm bush (2x sheet 512-576, 548-612) keeps the old palette (bac668/84a03e/587e30, hue 67-89) and is not muddier than before. Bushes are now lower and flatter, which leaves the top of each 32x32 cell empty. That is acceptable.

ground.notes: woodland_west AFTER (2x sheet box 512-736 x 676-932; 1x recipe-local coordinates below) has the same defects as warm group 5: a bare 9x35 px trunk pole at x40-48 y67-102 with a flat cut bottom and no roots, and two stray dark-green horizontal dashes on open grass at x15-20 y61 and x48-54 y87. woodland_north AFTER (2x 272-496 x 644-932): the middle-left crown (x12-50 y48-84) has no trunk and floats with a 1-3 px grass gap above the lower-left crown, and the upper-right tree's trunk stub (x54-63 y47-59) hangs in open grass. light_trees AFTER (2x 656-912 x 172-332): the contact shadows are now dark-green crescent or hook fragments (local x~213-243 y~115-128 and x~146-200 y~137-147) that read as dark arcs rather than ground shadows. Minor. The neck and roots pieces are clean.

warm.notes: Colour is fixed: the yellow-green highlights are afbc51 and b0cc58, hue 67-74 with saturation 0.57. That is not mustard or olive, and in river-town the warm trees read as fresh yellow-green. Structure is not fixed. Group 5 AFTER (2x sheet 0-224 x 1210-1468, 1x local) has a tall bare trunk pole at x40-48 y67-102 with no roots, and dark dashes at x15-20 y61 and x48-54 y87. Group 4 AFTER (2x 1088-1312 x 644-932) has the same floating crown with no trunk (x12-50 y48-84, 1-3 px gap at x20-40 y84-87) and a hanging trunk stub (x54-63 y47-59). The three-tree row AFTER (2x 0-256 / 544-800 x 772-932) has crescent shadow fragments and a detached dark dash below the second tree's roots (2x ~x537-577 y~879). The shadow-only recipes are clean. The 2x2 dark speck at g4 local (80-81, 14-15) was already in BEFORE.

canopy.notes: The new broadleaf crowns mix with the unchanged conifers without seams. Tints vary and no grid reads at 1x. The dark 0c2222 voids at the top rim (canopy_after ~x77-95 y44-57 and ~x180-197 y44-57) and between crowns are as large as the ones in BEFORE, so they predate this change. The bottom edges of crowns in the fill are flat and horizontal, which is a property of the autotile and also matches BEFORE.

forest_in_context.notes: tool-village: the forest bottom row (after half, map ~x0-100 y600-620) now has three different trees: different drawings and tints, with no pixel-identical block found by search. The orchard look is gone. river-town, village50 and facilities: the tree rows read as a natural mixed grove, with no repeated copies and no cut crowns. In river-town the right tree of a trio overlaps its neighbour with a lit, outline-free left edge (after map x75-77 y1066-1087). It is acceptable but soft. The tall-pole and floating-crown recipes were not seen in these four maps, but any map that uses woodland_west, woodland_north or warm group 4/5 will show them.
